name: pbc-official-development-reproduction-v1

decision_contract.primary_ranking: smallest aggregate pattern-plus-payload bytes from one fixed official PBC method
decision_contract.oracle_ranking: best method per family is context only and cannot support the primary claim
decision_contract.compression_time: pattern-training median plus online file-compression median
decision_contract.online_compression_time: file-compression median with the canonical pattern already available
decision_contract.decompression_time: file-decompression median including pattern and payload loading
decision_contract.archive_bytes: pattern file bytes plus compressed payload bytes
decision_contract.roundtrip: restored size and SHA-256 must exactly match the source file

claim_ceiling: official PBC development-corpus reproduction only; blind validation remains sealed
